scope.summary: Snapshot of the CNESS directory service, 23 November 2026
paragraphs: This preview shows the 490 listed and 16 featured organizations that the directory service at cnessworks.com returned on 23 November 2026, in the service’s own order. Counts, pages and filters cover that snapshot, not the live directory.

Badge, size, country and Certified only filters, the six focus areas and the searches the service answered during the capture show the service’s own results. Any other search or industry is matched in your browser against the snapshot and is marked Preview match; cnessworks.com can return different results.
Profiles, bookmarks, ratings and the listing plans open on cnessworks.com. Impression and view counting is not connected in this preview, and the rating breakdown (stars by count) is not included.
